text: Jeff can fix your sales process.  It can listen to a sales call live and tell you what to say next, what objection you are  hearing, what stage of the call you're in, and even probability of closing.  Instead of making an LLM thing through the whole conversation, which is super slow, Jeff  can make those small decisions extremely fast.  Then your agents use that signal to coach the rep in real time.  This is exactly why I keep saying generate, Jeff decide, but Jeff is changing the paradigm  of what we are doing with agents and sales might be one of the best use cases for it.  And if you want to learn more about Jeff use cases and how to use them for your businesses,  comment Jeff.
